meaning_en: to anchor / dock firmly in harbor

past.ar: أَرْسَى النَّوْخِذَةُ سَفِينَتَهُ فِي الخَلِيجِ الهَادِئِ
past.de: Der Kapitän ankerte sein Schiff in der ruhigen Bucht
past.en: The captain anchored his ship in the peaceful bay

present.de: Er macht das Fahrzeug am Steinkai fest
present.en: He moors the craft by the stone pier

imperative.de: Wirf den Anker in Frieden und Sicherheit!
imperative.en: Drop anchor with calm peace and confidence!
